node.build: Official 11.2.1 Linux amd64 release asset; SHA256 88276ed753f460ee876c03c305ad68de9e4a16945f7c741e08130bf296791174 (GitHub marks this tag as a prerelease).

run.cli: cardano-cli 11.7.0.0 from the same release archive
setup: One stake pool, three DReps, no constitutional committee, testnet magic 42, 200-slot epochs of 0.1 s, generated with cardano-testnet create-env.

ExperimentalHardForksEnabled and TestDijkstraHardForkAtEpoch 2 in the generated versioned configuration. The epoch trigger changes the era but initially leaves protocol version 10. Two governance actions raised it to 11 then 12.

The recorded transaction matrix ran after checking protocol version 12. It has 32 encodings: the 25 of the 2026-11-09 matrix plus a native guard, a PlutusV4 guard and an account balance interval (cardano-cli 11.7 added the options), with their mempool encodings, and a balance interval the account does not meet, which the node rejects.

Ogmios and Kupo, releases and forks, were run with a flattened legacy configuration equivalent to the versioned one, as on 11.2.0, when both rejected the versioned envelope; that rejection was not re-tested on 11.2.1. db-sync needs Protocol and LastKnownBlockVersion fields plus a Shelley genesis copy rounded to Byron whole-second startTime.

Only what ran on 2026-11-23 is recorded, plus a rerun of the IntersectMBO Ogmios and Kupo forks at newer commits on 2026-11-24 against the same chain, served by a plain node (forks.sh relay) because cardano-testnet cannot restart an old chain; the 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-11 results stay in the archived assessment. Version labels name exactly what ran: current releases and prereleases, Pallas main, the IntersectMBO Ogmios and Kupo forks, blockfrost-platform main, and txtop's latest release with its gouroboros pin raised.
Raw logs, fixtures, resolved build inputs and checksums are retained under content/readiness/dijkstra-runs/2026-11-23/. No signing keys, mnemonics or credentials are retained.

Not run: Koios (it reads the db-sync tables, and db-sync stops before the advanced transactions), required top-level guards, the historical patched gouroboros controls and cardano-node-api, and the Ogmios v7.0.0 and Kupo v2.12 releases against the versioned configuration (on 2026-11-24 Kupo fork e9ef0be3 read it and synced; Ogmios fork 20c383a2 exited asking for ByronGenesisFile and ShelleyGenesisFile). Pass means only the capability and cases named by that check.
